image_description: A close-up shot of two lighters resting on a human hand. The primary subject is a tall, cylindrical lighter with an iridescent purple and blue metallic finish. To its left is a standard rectangular disposable lighter, pink in color, with the brand name 'LOFTON' visible. A flame is actively burning from the top of the cylindrical lighter. The background is a blurred skin tone, indicating the objects are held in a palm.
